entries.title: Mark 14:1
segments: And after two days it was the Passover and [the Feast of] Unleavened [Bread]. And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take Him by craft and kill [Him].

entries.title: Mark 14:2
segments: But they said, Not during the Feast, lest there be an uproar of the people.

entries.title: Mark 14:3
segments: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as He reclined, a woman came with an alabaster vial of pure, costly ointment of spikenard. And she broke the vial and poured [it] on His head.

entries.title: Mark 14:4
segments: And some were indignant to themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

entries.title: Mark 14:5
segments: For it might have been sold [for] more than three hundred denarii, and be given to the poor. And they were incensed with her.

entries.title: Mark 14:6
segments: And Jesus said, Let her alone! Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work towards Me.

entries.title: Mark 14:7
segments: For you have the poor with you always, and whenever you desire you may do them good. But you do not have Me always.

entries.title: Mark 14:8
segments: She has done what she could. She has come beforehand to anoint My body for the burying.

entries.title: Mark 14:9
segments: Truly I say to you, Wherever this gospel shall be proclaimed in all the world, [this] also that she has done will be spoken of for a memorial of her.

entries.title: Mark 14:10
segments: And Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray Him to them.

entries.title: Mark 14:11
segments: And when they heard, they were glad and promised to give him silver. And he sought how he might conveniently betray Him.

entries.title: Mark 14:12
segments: And the first day of Unleavened [Bread], when they killed the passover, His disciples said to Him, Where do You desire that we go and prepare that You may eat the passover?

entries.title: Mark 14:13
segments: And He sent out two of His disciples and said to them, Go into the city, and there you shall meet a man bearing a pitcher of water. Follow him.

entries.title: Mark 14:14
segments: And wherever he may go in, you say to the housemaster, The Teacher says, Where is the guest room where I shall eat the passover with My disciples?

entries.title: Mark 14:15
segments: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished [and] prepared. Prepare there for us.

entries.title: Mark 14:16
segments: And His disciples went out and came into the city and found [it] as He had said to them. And they made the passover ready.

entries.title: Mark 14:17
segments: And in the evening He came with the Twelve.

entries.title: Mark 14:18
segments: And as they reclined and ate, Jesus said, Truly I say to you, One of you will betray Me, the [one] eating with Me.

entries.title: Mark 14:19
segments: And they began to be grieved, and to say to Him one by one, Not at all I, [is it]? And another said, Not at all I, [is it]?

entries.title: Mark 14:20
segments: And answering He said to them, [It is] one of the Twelve, the [one] dipping with Me in the dish.

entries.title: Mark 14:21
segments: The Son of man indeed goes, as it has been written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! It were good for that man if he had never been born.

entries.title: Mark 14:22
segments: And [as] they ate, Jesus took a loaf and blessed and broke [it], and He gave to them and said, Take, eat; this is My body.

entries.title: Mark 14:23
segments: And taking the cup, giving thanks, He gave to them. And they all drank out of it.

entries.title: Mark 14:24
segments: And He said to them, This is My blood of the New Covenant, which is poured out for many.

entries.title: Mark 14:25
segments: Truly I say to you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Mark 14:26
segments: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

entries.title: Mark 14:27
segments: And Jesus said to them, All of you will be offended because of Me this night. For it is written, "I will smite the Shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered."

entries.title: Mark 14:28
segments: But after I am raised, I will go before you into Galilee.

entries.title: Mark 14:29
segments: But Peter said to Him, Although all shall be offended, yet I [will] not.

entries.title: Mark 14:30
segments: And Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that today, in this night, before the cock crows twice, you shall deny Me three times.

entries.title: Mark 14:31
segments: But he spoke the more fervently, If I should die with You, I will not deny You in any way. Also they all said likewise.

entries.title: Mark 14:32
segments: And they came to a place named Gethsemane. And He said to His disciples, Sit here while I pray.

entries.title: Mark 14:33
segments: And He took with Him Peter and James and John. And He began to be greatly amazed, and to be very heavy.

entries.title: Mark 14:34
segments: And He said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful to death. Stay here and watch.

entries.title: Mark 14:35
segments: And He went forward a little and fell on the ground. And He prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from Him.

entries.title: Mark 14:36
segments: And He said, Abba, Father, all things [are] possible to You. Take away this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You [will].

entries.title: Mark 14:37
segments: And He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, do you sleep? Could you not watch one hour?

entries.title: Mark 14:38
segments: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. Truly the spirit [is] willing, but the flesh [is] weak.

entries.title: Mark 14:39
segments: And again He went away and prayed and spoke the same words.

entries.title: Mark 14:40
segments: And when He returned, He found them asleep again (for their eyes were heavy), neither did they know what to answer Him.

entries.title: Mark 14:41
segments: And He came the third time and said to them, Sleep on now and take [your] rest. It is enough, the hour has come. Behold, the Son of man has been betrayed into the hands of sinners.

entries.title: Mark 14:42
segments: Rise up, let us go. Lo, he who betrays Me is at hand.

entries.title: Mark 14:43
segments: And immediately, while He still spoke, Judas, being one of the Twelve, came, and with him a great crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

entries.title: Mark 14:44
segments: And he who betrayed Him had given them a sign, saying, Whomever I shall kiss, [it] is He. Take Him and lead [Him] away safely.

entries.title: Mark 14:45
segments: And coming, at once drawing near to Him, he said, Rabbi, Rabbi! And [he] ardently kissed Him.

entries.title: Mark 14:46
segments: And they laid their hands on Him and seized Him.

entries.title: Mark 14:47
segments: And one of those standing by, drawing a sword, struck a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

entries.title: Mark 14:48
segments: And answering Jesus said to them, Have you come out with swords and clubs, as against a robber, to take Me?

entries.title: Mark 14:49
segments: I was with you daily in the temple teaching, and you did not seize Me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.

entries.title: Mark 14:50
segments: And leaving Him, all fled.

entries.title: Mark 14:51
segments: And one, a certain young man, followed Him, having thrown a linen cloth around [his] naked [body]. And the young men caught him.

entries.title: Mark 14:52
segments: And he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

entries.title: Mark 14:53
segments: And they led Jesus away to the high priest. And with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

entries.title: Mark 14:54
segments: And Peter followed Him from a distance to the inside of the court of the high priest. And he sat with the servants and warmed himself at the fire.

entries.title: Mark 14:55
segments: And the chief priests and all the sanhedrin sought for witness against Jesus, to put Him to death. And [they] found none.

entries.title: Mark 14:56
segments: For many testified falsely against Him, but the testimonies were not identical.

entries.title: Mark 14:57
segments: And certain ones rose up and bore false witness against Him, saying,

entries.title: Mark 14:58
segments: We heard Him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

entries.title: Mark 14:59
segments: But neither was their testimony identical.

entries.title: Mark 14:60
segments: And standing up in the middle, the high priest questioned Jesus, saying, Do you answer nothing? What [do] these witness against you?

entries.title: Mark 14:61
segments: But He was silent and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked Him, saying to Him, Are you the Christ, the son of the Blessed?

entries.title: Mark 14:62
segments: And Jesus said, I AM! And you will see the Son of man sitting on the right [hand] of power and coming in the clouds of the heaven.

entries.title: Mark 14:63
segments: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, What further need do we have of witnesses?

entries.title: Mark 14:64
segments: You have heard the blasphemy; what do you think? And they all condemned Him to be guilty of death.

entries.title: Mark 14:65
segments: And some began to spit on Him, and to cover His face and to beat Him, and to say to Him, Prophesy! And the under-officers struck Him with slaps.

entries.title: Mark 14:66
segments: And as Peter was below in the palace, one of the servant women of the high priest came.

entries.title: Mark 14:67
segments: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked on him and said, And you also were with Jesus the Nazarene.

entries.title: Mark 14:68
segments: But he denied, saying, I do not know nor even understand what you are saying. And he went out into the forecourt. And a cock crowed.

entries.title: Mark 14:69
segments: And a servant woman saw him again and began to say to those who stood by, This [one] is of them.

entries.title: Mark 14:70
segments: And he denied it again. And a little after, those who stood by said again to Peter, Surely you are [one] of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech agrees.

entries.title: Mark 14:71
segments: But he began to curse and to swear, [saying], I do not know this man of whom you speak.

entries.title: Mark 14:72
segments: And the second time a cock crowed. And Peter remembered the word that Jesus said to him, Before a cock crows twice, you will deny Me three times. And thinking on [it], he wept.
